description: The Investment Data Area (IDA) is AllianzGI’s home for investment-management-related data products. Today IDA owns ten established data products (incl. Positions & Transactions, Issuer & Security Information, Benchmark & Market Index Data, Investment Key Figures, and Performance & Attribution, among others), which share dependencies and largely leverage IDS, AllianzGI’s strategic partner for investment data services. Vendor Market Data (VMD) will be IDA’s eleventh data product. As the Data Product Owner (f/m/d) for Vendor Market Data, you will report to the Investment Data Area Business Lead and be responsible for delivering AI-ready, quality-assessed, lineage-tracked vendor and research data to business stakeholders. To reach your goals, you will be supported by your Squad, part of AllianzGI’s Investment Data Area Tech, and work alongside Data Stewards, Business / Data Analysts and Engineers within the Squad. In this role, you serve as the functional lead, responsible for driving the Squad’s work through a clear Product Vision and Strategy. Your mission is to grow VMD from its current scope into the single governed raw-data layer for all vendor and research data consumed by investment teams and beyond – owning ingestion (native, API, SFTP), data quality, access management, lineage and cataloguing in Unity Catalog, while consuming teams build their own models and analytics on top. You will manage the Squad’s Backlog, set priorities across onboarding waves, and define requirements to ensure alignment with strategic objectives. Balancing business and technical priorities, you will guide the Squad to deliver data solutions that meet organizational goals, focusing on maximizing customer value through effective product management. This position will be based in Frankfurt, Munich, Hong Kong or Singapore. What You Will Do Product Ownership & Agile Delivery Define and communicate the vision, mission, and roadmap for the Vendor Market Data Product. Own and manage the product backlog in JIRA, translating documented data demands from Risklab, Equity, Fixed Income, Multi Asset, and Investment Research into actionable epics and user stories. Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and review ceremonies in collaboration with the Agile Master. Prioritize onboarding of vendors and datasets (native delta-sharing, API, SFTP) according to business value and squad capacity. Develop and own the global VMD operating model, data domains and ingestion patterns, ensuring every dataset is catalogued and lineage-tracked in Unity Catalog. Manage the research and resolution of data discrepancies and quality issues, involving appropriate resources within the squad. Collaborate with Market Data Services (MDS) on license management and ensure appropriate data access management. Identify and drive migration of existing, duplicated data flows into the governed VMD platform. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the primary liaison between consuming Investment stakeholders, investment tech products and the VMD Squad, ensuring raw data ownership stays with IDA while consuming teams refine their own models and analytics on top. Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops with investment teams and beyond to document and prioritize data needs, including scoping not-yet-documented requirements (e.g. Research Team). Coordinate with other Data Product Owners within IDA as well as with DPA to ensure alignment on data architecture, governance and shared platform usage. Organize and lead stand-ups, retrospectives, and review sessions with impacted stakeholders. Create firmwide transparency on vendor data sourcing, licensing terms, lineage and quality, ensuring consumers understand and trust the data. Partner with MDS / Procurement on vendor contract and licensing terms (incl. AI usage), and with the ODP Platform team on infrastructure and streaming architecture decisions. Serve as business partner for ITA leadership and investment teams on all matters relating to vendor and market / research data. Strategic Alignment & Communication Maximize business value while protecting the squad’s autonomy and delivery flexibility. Ensure transparent communication of timelines, dependencies, open decisions and risks (e.g. vendor contracts, streaming architecture) to all stakeholders. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, excellence, collaboration, and agile maturity. Work closely together with Chapter Leads by defining the set of necessary competences in the Squad. Share fair and transparent feedback on the Squad members with their respective Chapter Lead. What You Bring Academic background in Data & Technology, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field, with a strong understanding of data-driven business strategies. Several years of relevant experience in market / vendor data management, data product ownership or asset management. Solid understanding of financial market data vendors and products (e.g. Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG, FactSet, ICE, Moody’s, S&P, ISS ESG, Markit, etc.) and their delivery mechanisms (native delta-sharing, API, SFTP, etc.). Familiarity with vendor contract and licensing considerations (usage rights, redistribution, entitlements) and ability to partner with Legal / Procurement. Knowledge of data governance, data lineage, data quality, and cataloguing frameworks, ideally including Databricks Unity Catalog. Experience with JIRA, agile delivery and data product lifecycle management; strong facilitation skills for agile ceremonies and stakeholder workshops. Ability to define and manage a multi-wave product vision, roadmap and backlog, and to translate complex, cross-team data requirements into clear, actionable user stories. Strong prioritization, value-delivery and stakeholder-alignment skills across a broad set of investment teams and vendors. Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build trustful relationships with squad members, Chapter Leads, investment stakeholders and vendors. International mentality with a strong interest to collaborate across locations and regions in a global organization. Fluency in English both written and spoken, with additional languages considered an advantage. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple vendor onboarding streams and deadlines in parallel. Demonstrated initiative to take on new challenges and drive change, continuously improving data sourcing and governance practices. What We Offer We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours) Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans Shared success: Company share purchasing plan Support for what matters: Mental health and wellbeing programs Investments in your career: Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group Investments in your skills: Comprehensive learning and development offerings, including certifications and professional qualifications Volunteering time … and so much more! About Allianz Global Investors Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience. We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing. Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters. When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors. Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly. Join us. Let’s care for tomorrow. How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the “ Additional Information ” section, and submit your application. To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience. Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process. 108904 | Data & AI | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | Permanent

description: Location Dublin Business Area Product Ref # 10054717 Description & Requirements At Bloomberg Enterprise Data, we’re fast-paced, innovative and growing. Our deep expertise in financial markets and technology enables us to work closely with clients to understand their business, workflow and data needs. With an extensive range of datasets across asset classes, flexible delivery technologies and tailored scheduling, we provide clients with the precise data they need, when and how they need it. Simply put, our award-winning data powers the capital markets. Data License+ (DL+) is a growing part of Bloomberg’s Enterprise Data business. DL+ is Bloomberg’s next-generation Data License platform, providing a managed service that brings Bloomberg data together in a standardized data model for more consistent and efficient consumption across clients’ systems and workflows. What's the role? We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to help shape and grow DL+. This role sits at the intersection of clients, data and technology. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Sales, Product Specialists, Operations and clients to understand evolving market needs and translate them into a clear product strategy and roadmap. You’ll own a defined area of the platform: setting the strategic product direction, identifying the most important client and market problems to solve, and defining the outcomes we want to achieve. You will partner with Engineering and other teams to turn those outcome priorities into solutions that deliver measurable value for clients and the business. The ideal candidate combines strong product management experience with an understanding of enterprise data and the evolving needs of buy-side and sell-side firms. You’ll be comfortable moving between strategic thinking, client discovery, data and technical discussions, and execution. We'll Trust You To Own the strategy, outcomes and priorities for a defined area of DL+, with clear accountability for the what and why Develop a deep understanding of client workflows, market dynamics and competitive trends to identify the highest-value problems to solve Develop a strong understanding of the DL+ platform, its components, including how new content and capabilities affect the broader model and client experience As a Product Manager on the team, we’ll expect you to manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, including: Discovery: Identify and validate client and market problems using qualitative and quantitative evidence Product design: Translate validated problems into a clear and compelling product narrative, defined outcomes and product requirements Refinement: Partner with Engineering to translate desired outcomes and product requirements into feasible solutions, features and delivery plans Execution: Work with Engineering to establish shared objectives (OKRs) and incremental progress metrics to track progress, success measurements and proactively make informed trade-offs as new information emerges Go-to-market: Partner with Commercial, Product Specialists, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure products and capabilities are ready for successful launch and adoption Product Viability: Leverage feedback loops to use adoption rates, client satisfaction and other success measures to evaluate product performance and inform future priorities Build strong communication channels across Product, Engineering, Sales, Operations and other internal/external teams - share product strategy, progress, decisions, risks and next steps clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders Continuously improve product management practices that strengthen accountability, decision-making and delivery across the team Foster a culture of delivery excellence, ownership, learning and focus on measurable outcomes You’ll Need To Have Product Management or business experience, ideally within financial services, enterprise data, FinTech or a similarly complex B2B technology environment Demonstrated experience owning outcomes, including defining objectives, priorities, key results and measuring success Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex problems, identify customer pain points, validate opportunities and use evidence to make decisions Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams to deliver complex products and platforms Sufficient technical fluency to engage effectively on data and platform topics; experience with technologies such as SQL, Python, APIs and cloud platforms is beneficial Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to simplify complex topics and influence across teams and levels Strong judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities, make trade-offs and maintain focus on the outcomes that matter most We’d Love To See Knowledge of securities markets and the trading lifecycle, including typical front-, middle- and back-office functions Knowledge of asset classes such as equities, fixed income, derivatives, indices and mortgages, and an understanding of their attributes and lifecycles Familiarity with financial data, including reference, pricing, FX, entity, research and OTC data Experience with data modelling or data platforms within financial services Experience building enterprise data products, managed services or platform products An interest in meeting clients and prospects, understanding their workflows and implementation challenges, and partnering with a global sales organization The ability to develop a strong point of view on the evolution of enterprise data and translate that perspective into product opportunities Passion for building products that solve complex client problems at scale If this sounds like you, please apply! We look forward to reviewing your application. If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

description: Job Description: Growth Manager Company: Bambinos.live Location: Bengaluru (On-site) Experience: 2–5 years Department: Growth Marketing Reporting to: Head of Growth Collaboration: Growth, Creative, Sales, Product and Data Teams About Bambinos Bambinos.live is an EdTech company offering live, small-group online classes for children aged 4–15. Our programs span leadership and life skills, Chess, Mathematics, English, Science, AI, and more. We serve families across India, the Middle East, and North America, supported by technology that helps parents track their child's learning progress. Role Overview We are looking for a results-driven Growth Manager to lead customer acquisition and drive business growth across multiple channels. This role involves building and optimizing marketing funnels, managing campaign budgets, experimenting with new acquisition channels, and improving conversion rates from lead generation to paid enrolment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in WhatsApp and email marketing, programmatic advertising, performance marketing, and data-driven growth strategies. Key Responsibilities 1. WhatsApp & Email Marketing Build and optimize WhatsApp journeys for lead nurturing, demo reminders, follow-ups, re-engagement, and conversion. Manage broadcast campaigns, audience segmentation, and opt-in compliance. Develop email lifecycle campaigns, including welcome sequences, lead nurturing, win-back, and referral campaigns. Monitor deliverability, engagement, and conversion metrics while conducting A/B tests. 2. Paid Acquisition & Performance Marketing Plan, test, and scale programmatic advertising through Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) and owned-and-operated (O&O) networks. Explore new paid acquisition channels across publisher, OTT, and app networks. Manage and scale Google Ads campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen. Optimize campaign budgets, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and landing pages. Collaborate across Meta and Google Ads to improve overall acquisition performance. 3. Growth Funnels & Conversion Optimization Own the complete customer journey: Lead Generation → Demo Booking → Demo Attendance → Paid Enrolment. Identify conversion gaps and implement strategies to improve funnel performance. Design and experiment with new acquisition funnels, including webinars, workshops, assessments, and lead magnets. Ensure accurate conversion tracking across advertising platforms and GA4. 4. Content & Organic Growth Identify opportunities to use short-form videos, parent testimonials, teacher-led content, and SEO to generate demand. Work with creative teams to develop high-performing marketing content. Use campaign insights and performance data to guide content strategy. 5. Referral, Influencer & Partnership Marketing Build referral and ambassador programs to drive customer acquisition. Develop influencer and creator partnerships within the parenting and education space. Establish partnerships with schools, parent communities, and complementary brands. Explore community-led growth opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency. 6. Analytics, Reporting & Budget Management Track key metrics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), cost per demo, demo attendance rate, conversion rate, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Analyse campaign performance by channel, course, and geography. Build dashboards and reports connecting marketing spend to revenue. Allocate budgets based on performance insights and growth opportunities. Present weekly performance updates and recommendations to leadership. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–5 years of experience in growth marketing or performance marketing, preferably in B2C, EdTech, or subscription-based businesses. Hands-on experience building WhatsApp marketing journeys using platforms such as WATI, Interakt, Gupshup, or AiSensy. Experience managing email lifecycle campaigns using tools such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Klaviyo, or Mailchimp. Practical experience running and scaling Google Ads campaigns. Hands-on experience with DSPs or O&O advertising networks, with a focus on conversions and revenue. Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, conversion optimization, and lifecycle marketing. Proficiency in GA4, Google Sheets/Excel, and marketing dashboards. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret attribution data and connect marketing performance to business outcomes. Ability to independently manage budgets, run experiments, identify growth opportunities, and take ownership of results. Good understanding of how paid, owned, earned, referral, and influencer channels work together. Good to Have Hands-on experience with Meta Ads. Experience in EdTech, children's learning, or parent-focused B2C businesses. Experience marketing across India, the Middle East, and North America. Working knowledge of SQL, Metabase, or Looker. Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), server-side tracking, or offline conversion uploads. Experience building referral or affiliate programs from scratch. Why Join Bambinos? Be part of a growing EdTech company serving families across multiple markets. Take ownership of growth strategy, experimentation, and customer acquisition. Work in a fast-paced environment where ideas can be tested and implemented quickly. Make a measurable impact on business growth and customer acquisition. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with a brief note describing one growth funnel they have managed, the improvements they implemented, and the measurable results achieved.
title: Growth Manager

description: Data Analyst, Marketplace Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditised, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. T he role As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. We are looking for a Data Analyst to help us understand how well our marketplace is working, identify where supply and demand are not connecting effectively, and measure whether product and algorithmic improvements are delivering better outcomes. You will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations teams, using data to answer important marketplace questions and support better product decisions. What you’ll bring to the role Strong Analytics Skills: Strong SQL skills and experience analysing complex datasets. Python experience for analysis and experimentation is beneficial. Marketplace or Product Analytics: Experience working with marketplace, product or operational data and using metrics to understand user and business behaviour. Marketplace Metrics: Ability to work with measures such as supply and demand, fill rate, time-to-fill, availability, quality and concentration to understand marketplace performance. Experimentation: Experience analysing A/B tests or other experiments, including defining success metrics, interpreting results and communicating findings. Product Thinking: Ability to turn product or marketplace questions into measurable hypotheses and structured analysis. Analytical Curiosity: Comfortable exploring data to understand why something is happening, rather than only reporting what happened. Commercial Awareness: Ability to understand how marketplace performance affects customer experience and wider business outcomes. Collaboration: Comfortable working with Product, Engineering and Operations teams and contributing analytical thinking to cross-functional work. Clear Communication: Ability to translate analysis into simple, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What you'll be doing Help define, monitor and improve the metrics we use to understand marketplace health, including supply-demand balance, fulfilment, quality and concentration. Analyse marketplace performance and investigate changes in metrics such as fill rate, time-to-fill, participant availability and quality. Work with product and engineering teams to define success metrics and measure the impact of product and algorithmic improvements. Analyse experiments to understand whether changes to matching, ranking, recommendation or other marketplace experiences are improving outcomes. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that make marketplace performance visible and actionable. Use SQL and other analytical tools to investigate marketplace behaviour, identify trends and surface opportunities or problems. Explore how marketplace outcomes differ across customers, participants, use cases and segments. Communicate findings clearly and help teams make data-informed product and operational decisions. Why Prolific is a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. Links to more information on Prolific Benefits External Handbook Website YouTube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal information.
title: Data Analyst - Marketplace

description: Join Barclays as a Digital Product Owner, where you'll be at the forefront of delivering client and colleague focused digital solutions through agile ways of working. This role requires an ample understanding of agile ceremonies, backlog management, and sprint planning, alongside the ability to translate user needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria. You'll use your commercial awareness to prioritise the backlog, align delivery with business goals, and maximise value for clients and the organisation. To be successful as a Digital Product Owner, you should have experience with: Agile mindset: deep understanding of agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning. Client needs: clear articulation of requirements and acceptance criteria. Commercial awareness: understands business goals to prioritise backlog. Collaboration: works closely with engineers, BAs, designers within squad. Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include KPI driven uses KPIs/OKRs to drive incremental value delivery. Collaboration and prioritisation: tactical prioritisation decisions (value vs effort, dependencies). You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. This role will be based in our Glasgow/London office. Purpose of the role The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques. Accountabilities Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements. Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story. Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
title: Digital Product Owner

description: Language requirement: German (C1+) OR Mandarin Chinese (equivalent professional fluency). Professional working proficiency in English required. About MAOMAO MAOMAO is building one of Germany's most exciting Asian food e-commerce businesses, combining online grocery, content, community, social commerce and our own consumer brands. With over 200,000 followers across social media, an established e-commerce business and a growing team, we're ready for our next stage of growth. We're looking for an exceptionally driven, analytical and entrepreneurial Growth & Strategy Manager to work directly with our founders, drive marketing performance and help scale MAOMAO. This isn't a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, takes ownership and has the potential to grow into a leadership position. What You'll Do Drive Growth: Identify opportunities to increase revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, average order value and customer retention. Scale TikTok Shop & Social Commerce: Help grow one of our most important sales channels by improving livestream performance, affiliate partnerships, promotional strategies and conversion. Own Marketing Performance: Monitor KPIs across TikTok Shop, livestreaming, social media, e-commerce and campaigns. Turn data into actionable improvements. Drive Marketing Execution: Take ownership of marketing priorities, coordinate our existing marketing and content team, monitor progress and ensure initiatives deliver measurable results. Lead Strategic Projects: Take ownership of growth initiatives, product launches and commercial experiments from idea to execution. Work With the Founders: Help make strategic decisions, challenge assumptions and turn ambitious goals into measurable results. Develop as a Leader: Take ownership of cross-functional projects from day one, with the opportunity to progressively assume direct team leadership based on performance. Who We're Looking For 2–5 years of relevant professional experience , ideally in management consulting, high-growth startups, business strategy, growth, e-commerce or a similarly demanding environment. Strong academic background in business, economics, management or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated ability. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with strong commercial thinking. Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects, influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business results. Entrepreneurial, ambitious and comfortable taking initiative and responsibility. Someone who doesn't just identify problems but actively develops and implements solutions. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the potential to lead people and teams. Fluent German (C1+) OR Mandarin Chinese (equivalent professional fluency) is mandatory. Professional working proficiency in English. Willingness to work primarily on-site with our team in Berlin. Experience with TikTok Shop, livestream commerce, affiliate marketing or social commerce is a strong advantage, but not required. We're particularly interested in candidates who combine analytical and commercial thinking with hands-on experience scaling digital businesses. You don't need to be an expert in every marketing channel. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, take ownership and turn opportunities into measurable results. Why Join MAOMAO? Real Ownership: Work on business-critical projects with measurable impact from day one. Direct Founder Exposure: Work closely with founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce. Leadership Opportunity: Develop into a leadership role as the company scales. Fast Learning Curve: Gain hands-on experience across growth, strategy, marketing and operations. Build Something Meaningful: Help make Asian food more accessible and exciting for millions of consumers. Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary based on experience and responsibility. description: Accepting Applications Until 27 November 2026 Job Description Job Title: Product Analyst Your new rol e We’re looking for a commercially minded Product Analyst with experience in product analytics, data analysis, or a similar insight-led role, ideally gained in a fast-paced, data-driven business. What You’ll Love About This Role Think Big: Help shape how data informs product thinking across DAX, bringing a strategic mindset to product discovery and decision-making. Own It: Take responsibility for turning ambiguous questions into clear analysis, actionable insight, and meaningful recommendations. Keep it Simple: Use data to cut through complexity, focusing on the metrics and insights that matter most. Better Together: Collaborate across squads, disciplines, and stakeholders to help build a stronger, more insight-led product organisation. description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced, Arabic-speaking Business Analyst to work with business stakeholders and technical teams and turn business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Build Jira boards, dashboards, filters and reports to track progress. Document requirements and knowledge in Confluence or equivalent tools. Collaboration and Quality Act as the bridge between business stakeholders, developers, QA, architects and project management. Support test planning by reviewing test cases and scenarios against requirements. Facilitate UAT, including coordinating with business users, logging defects and tracking sign-off. Manage change requests and impact analysis. Support go-live, training materials and post-implementation reviews. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. Native or fluent Arabic (spoken and written) and professional-level English . Proven experience writing BRD, FRD and FSD documents. Hands-on expertise with Jira (user stories, backlog management, workflows, reporting). Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology. Proficiency in flow diagrams and process diagrams (BPMN, UML, flowcharts) using Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io or similar. Solid grasp of the SDLC and requirements management practices. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and presentation skills.
